outcome: Give Banking teams a working Next-Best-Action Wealth & Cross-Sell Advisory Engine capability on their own data — it lifts cross-sell conversion and fee-based wealth revenue.
overview: Wealth and investment products carry the fee margin retail banking needs, yet eligible clients are rarely offered them — relationship managers cannot read every portfolio, and blanket campaigns waste the ones they do reach. The Next-Best-Action Wealth & Cross-Sell Advisory Engine ranks each client's propensity across the product catalogue against holdings, transactions and stated risk appetite, then serves the leading recommendation to the RM desktop and digital channels fast enough to use in conversation. Suitability and the advice itself remain with the relationship manager. Five to six weeks on the bank's own book shows whether conversion moves against the recorded baseline.
